snippet.title: Walkabout Mini Golf - Official Passport Venice Overview Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Join senior art director Don Carson at developer Mighty Coconut for a deep dive into the creation of the Passport Venice course for Walkabout Mini Golf. Walkabout Mini Golf's Passport Venice is free to play during the weekend of July 11 to July 14, 2025.
